tweets.text:
It's really good, actually! Meta got their act together.
New contender for America's Next Top Model

I tested it against my last several Claude queries, and the Meta answers were better in my limited test.

Stock up 8%.
https://t.co/zs2unIJWsv https://t.co/PRncCVJTZR

Fun nine months! My first week i remember we had a long dinner in the cafeteria daydreaming about the cool research directions to pursue, then going to back to our desks to write a basic script to inference llama. Now we have a pretty complete stack and our first model is out 🥑 https://t.co/9j3TmpbOSW

After playing with it a bit, Meta's Muse Spark Thinking is fine so far, but really doesn't match the current Big Three models. It also is a bit... weird. Like some strange language & tone, a little loose with facts, etc.

And here is how it does on the neo-gothic shader test. https://t.co/aDlcslfdSu https://t.co/hxsUTOVTO3
